q.1: What jobs in the Czech Republic are currently available for Ukrainians?
q.2: Is official employment available in the Czech Republic for Ukrainians?
q.3: Is knowledge of Czech required to work in the Czech Republic?
q.4: Is housing provided with jobs in the Czech Republic?
q.5: What is the salary for jobs in the Czech Republic for Ukrainians?
q.6: Do you help with document processing for work in the Czech Republic?
q.7: How many hours per week can you work in the Czech Republic?
q.8: Are there jobs in the Czech Republic for married couples?
q.9: How quickly can you leave for work in the Czech Republic?
q.10: How do I apply for a job in the Czech Republic?

a.1: We offer official jobs in the Czech Republic for Ukrainians in warehouses, manufacturing, logistics, the food industry, cleaning, and caregiving. Vacancies are available across the entire Czech Republic — Prague, Brno, Pilsen, and other cities. Offers are available for men, women, and married couples.
a.2: Yes, all our vacancies include official employment in accordance with Czech law. Every worker receives an employment contract, an official salary, and social insurance. We help arrange all the necessary documents.
a.3: For most positions, knowledge of Czech is not required. We have a large number of offers for candidates without language skills — especially in manufacturing, warehouses, and logistics. We also provide support in Ukrainian at every stage.
a.4: Yes, for most vacancies the employer or agency provides housing for workers. Living conditions depend on the specific vacancy and company. Some offers include free or partially paid housing.
a.5: The salary level depends on the position, number of working hours, and shifts. The average salary ranges from 140 to 220 CZK/hour. Many vacancies include the possibility of overtime and night shift bonuses.
a.6: Yes, we fully support clients at every stage: we help with work permit processing, registration, and preparation of the necessary documents. Our managers consult in Ukrainian and answer all questions.
a.7: On average, a working day is 8–12 hours, 5–6 days a week. Additional overtime hours are available for many vacancies. The specific schedule depends on the company and the chosen position.
a.8: Yes, we have special vacancies for married couples with the possibility of living and working together at the same company. This is one of the most popular categories among Ukrainians looking for work in the Czech Republic.
a.9: Starting work is possible within a few days after the vacancy is agreed upon and the documents are prepared. Timelines depend on the specific position and the candidate's document readiness.
a.10: To apply, leave a request on our website or contact us by phone or messenger. Our manager will get in touch, select current vacancies in the Czech Republic, and help with all the documents.

privacyPolicy.heading: Privacy Policy (GDPR)
privacyPolicy.description: This Privacy Policy explains how FLOVAS s.r.o. collects, uses, stores and protects the personal data you provide through the website

item1.heading: Who is the controller of your personal data?
item1.txt1: The controller of your personal data is FLOVAS s.r.o.
item1.txt2: FLOVAS s.r.o. determines the purposes and means of processing personal data and is responsible for processing it in accordance with applicable law, in particular Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council ("GDPR").

item2.heading: What personal data do we collect?
item2.txt1: Through the contact forms on our website, we may collect the following personal data:
item2.txt5: preferred profession or field of work;
item2.txt6: a message or other information that you voluntarily provide in the message text.
item2.txt7: We process only the personal data that is necessary for the relevant purpose.

item3.heading: What do we use your personal data for?
item3.txt1: We use the personal data you provide for:
item3.txt2: contacting you in response to your inquiry or message.
item3.txt4: providing information about available employment opportunities based on your stated preferences regarding the city and profession.
item3.txt5: further communication with you when necessary to discuss your inquiry or employment opportunities.

item4.heading: What is the legal basis for processing your data?
item4.txt1: We process personal data on the basis of:
item4.txt2: your consent – when you voluntarily provide us with your personal data through the contact form;
item4.txt3: taking steps at your request prior to entering into a contract – if your inquiry concerns potential employment or cooperation;
item4.txt4: our legitimate interest – for properly handling received inquiries, maintaining communication and protecting our legitimate rights.

item5.heading: Do we share your personal data with third parties?
item5.txt1: We do not sell, publish or share your personal data with third parties for their own purposes.
item5.txt2: The data you provide is stored in the internal database of FLOVAS s.r.o. and is used by authorized employees of the company solely for contacting you, processing your inquiry and providing information about employment opportunities.
item5.txt3: Your personal data is not shared with employers, other companies or other third parties without your prior consent.
item5.txt4: In cases required by law, personal data may be provided to the competent government authorities where such disclosure is legally required.

item6.heading: How long do we retain your personal data?
item6.txt1: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to achieve the purposes for which it was collected.
item6.txt2: Data provided through the contact form may be stored in the internal database of FLOVAS s.r.o. to enable further communication with you regarding your inquiry and relevant employment opportunities.
item6.txt3: If you no longer wish us to retain your personal data, you may contact us using the contact details provided below and request its deletion, provided there are no legal grounds for continued retention.
item6.txt4: Once the purpose of processing has been fulfilled or the necessary retention period has expired, personal data will be deleted or securely destroyed.

item7.heading: Your rights
item7.txt1: Under the GDPR, you have the right to:
item7.txt3: request the correction of inaccurate or incomplete data;
item7.txt4: request the deletion of your personal data where the conditions of the GDPR are met;
item7.txt5: request restriction of the processing of your personal data;
item7.txt6: object to certain types of processing of your personal data;
item7.txt7: withdraw your consent at any time where processing is based on consent;
item7.txt8: where applicable, receive your personal data in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format;
item7.txt9: lodge a complaint with the competent data protection supervisory authority.

item8.heading: Right to lodge a complaint
